newsitem.title: UK: GKN shares firm after NatWest comment.
newsitem.headline: GKN shares firm after NatWest comment.

text.p: Shares in auto components and defence group GKN Plc rose in a falling market on Friday as NatWest Securities repeated a positive view on the stock, dealers said.
By 1129 GMT the stock was up four pence at 992-1/2p in volume of 1.3 million, even as the FTSE 100 index was down 43.5 points at 4,228.0.
Market sources said NatWest was positive on the stock because it had been oversold last week and the potential damage from a U.S. court case was exaggerated.

GKN has calculated it could have to pay out a maximum of $554 million in a U.S. class action by a group of franchisees but analysts said this did not threaten the company's capacity to grow through acquisitions.
